name: openthrottle-app
description: OpenThrottle | App: Electron desktop shell around the Developer app.

metadata.description: Build the Electron main and preload bundles to {projectRoot}/out with electron-vite. Runs after openthrottle-developer:build, whose output the packaged app embeds.

Run the Electron shell in development with electron-vite (opens the app window). install-electron first fetches the Electron binary (a no-op once it matches the locked version): electron-vite reads node_modules/electron/path.txt itself and never triggers electron's lazy download, so a clean install would fail with "Error: Electron uninstall".

Stage the traced runtime closure (scripts/stage-app.ts), then package an ad-hoc-signed OpenThrottle.app and zip with electron-builder into {projectRoot}/dist/release (dist/release/mac-arm64 on Apple silicon). `--configuration=universal` builds one arm64+x64 bundle into dist/release/mac-universal instead; it needs both arches' ripgrep packages, so run `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --cpu=arm64 --cpu=x64` first. Not cached: the output is hundreds of MB and the tracer reads the pnpm store, which Nx does not hash.

Opt-in smoke test of the PACKAGED app (scripts/smoke-packaged-app.ts): ditto dist/release/mac-arm64/OpenThrottle.app to a temp dir, launch it with an empty env (only OPENTHROTTLE_SERVER_URL, pointed at a stub OT server) and a fresh --user-data-dir, read the embedded port from stderr, check /__shell/health, GET /auth and POST /graphql through the proxy, then kill it. Exits non-zero on any failure so the release job can gate on it. Does not depend on package (run package first); macOS only. `--configuration=universal` smokes dist/release/mac-universal natively; `--configuration=universal-x64` launches its x64 slice under Rosetta (`--arch x64`). Not cached; run by the release workflow (.github/workflows/openthrottle-app-release.yml), never by PR CI.

Opt-in, LOCAL-ONLY smoke e2e: launches the built Electron app with Playwright _electron against a running, seeded OT server (OPENTHROTTLE_SERVER_URL, default http://localhost:6021), signs in as the seeded developer user, asserts the home route and a plan detail page. Skips visibly when the server is unreachable. Not part of test, not cached, not run by CI.

Type-check the Electron shell source, tests and config with tsc --noEmit, then the connection-screen renderer (bundler resolution, DOM) with its own tsconfig (source-first: electron-vite emits the runtime bundles).
